import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# All source tables have the exact same schema as the target:
# ['Name', 'Team', 'Position', 'SnapsPlayed']
# According to Hint 2 and Hint 4, we should UNION all source tables.

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (union)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the data types match the target schema:
# 'Name': string, 'Team': string, 'Position': string, 'SnapsPlayed': integer
combined_df['Name'] = combined_df['Name'].astype(str)
combined_df['Team'] = combined_df['Team'].astype(str)
combined_df['Position'] = combined_df['Position'].astype(str)
combined_df['SnapsPlayed'] = combined_df['SnapsPlayed'].astype(int)

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_56/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
